cycle.name: Foundation and workflow depth · first cycle + open-source readiness

items.title: Public source and contributor onboarding
items.acceptance: A clean source checkout passes portable verification without private reading material.
evidence: Public MIT source, third-party notices, contributor guides and private vulnerability reporting are available at https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon.
Clean source with empty private reading content passed portable verification: https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/actions/runs/37549463621
Clean Mac renderer build passed after verified public hand-model setup; guide now documents the required step.

items.title: Public website and honest product tour
items.acceptance: Responsive website serves on the custom domain with working source and community links.
evidence: Website build, unit checks, type checks, smoke harness and full browser suite passed in the existing GitHub Pages pipeline: https://github.com/JGOLD43/jevangoldsmith.com/actions/runs/37549733481
Custom domain returned HTTP 200 and expected homepage, dashboard and catalogue content at https://jevangoldsmith.com/theon/.
Desktop and mobile layout, plugin filters, catalogue copying, dashboard state filters and live metrics were checked; live dashboard had no browser errors.

items.title: Starter catalogue and plugin proposal path
items.acceptance: Three immutable starter bundles have matching checksums and a native catalogue install succeeds.
evidence: Canonical HTTPS catalogue is live at https://jevangoldsmith.com/theon/plugins/catalogue.json with three Theon-authored offline starters.
Published Focus Timer, Scratchpad and Recall Cards passed checksum installation, separate enable/open and runtime isolation in a disposable native profile using the canonical website catalogue.
Public Discussions welcome and three bounded contributor opportunities are open; plugin proposal form, source/license, permissions and immutable bundle requirements are documented.

items.title: Active delivery measurement
items.acceptance: Receipt deduplication, bounded outcome evidence and dashboard refresh work; recurring observation is enabled.
evidence: Shipping tests passed receipt deduplication, private-path stripping, dated acceptance validation and partial observation coverage.
Production-build dashboard rendered public repository evidence without browser errors; state filters and catalogue copy worked.
Six-hour local observer is active and public release refresh workflow passed: https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/actions/runs/37549376754
Successful signed local installation used the backup-preserving installer and recorded only public-safe receipt fields.

items.title: Capture and resume real context
items.acceptance: Five mixed captures, three later lookups and one interrupted resume work with tolerable correction effort.

items.title: Finish three ordinary work outputs
items.acceptance: Three real outputs meet chosen criteria and retain context after interruption.

items.title: Dependable selected-context AI
items.acceptance: Inspect selected sharing, changes and undo across three ordinary tasks; no extra records leak.

items.title: Independent learning and delayed review
items.acceptance: One chosen skill path includes independent attempt, delayed recall and a fresh-case application.

items.title: Trustworthy time and weekly allocation
items.acceptance: Three mixed-app days show known and unknown coverage; one review changes an allocation.

items.title: Useful relationship preparation
items.acceptance: Three chosen conversations support useful recall and follow-through without compulsory logging.

items.title: Reliable import and reconciliation
items.acceptance: A disposable import reconciles and corrected records survive restart with unknowns explained.

items.title: Dependable health and chosen practices
items.acceptance: Three workouts and food days reopen correctly; one recipe and one practice adjustment are useful.

items.title: Ideas applied to decisions and tests
items.acceptance: One model clarifies a decision and one reviewed experiment changes a next action.

items.title: Saved media and trip context
items.acceptance: Three saved-title lookups and one chosen trip preparation or music discovery work.

items.title: Independent plugin author onboarding
items.acceptance: An outside author builds, installs, exports, updates and submits a plugin using the guide.

items.title: Protected contribution review
items.acceptance: Main requires pull requests and passing portable, Mac and publication checks; dependency alerts and security update proposals are enabled.
evidence: Live main protection requires PRs, current GitHub Actions portable/Mac/publication checks and resolved conversations, including admins; force pushes and deletion are disabled. Dependency alerts/update proposals, secret scanning and push protection are enabled.

items.title: Independent Mac contributor setup
items.acceptance: A fresh hosted Mac installs, builds and passes native browser/plugin isolation without maintainer credentials.
evidence: Independent clean Mac runner installed dependencies, built and passed native browser/plugin isolation: https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/actions/runs/37551876007
Local fresh dependencies with Node 24 passed portable checks and disposable native browser/plugin fixtures; no maintainer credentials or private source bodies were needed.

items.title: Privacy and redistribution clearance
items.acceptance: Published-source history, inventory and corresponding source are reviewed, and pending component redistribution terms are resolved.
evidence: History/source and locked-package review passed; nonfree FFmpeg replaced and exact hand-model terms verified. Downloader bundled-dependency source coverage remains https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/issues/10; not accepted.

items.title: Dependable community contribution path
items.acceptance: Named maintainership, private reporting, API v1 compatibility and author tooling are documented and validated; real outside authorship remains a separate outcome.
evidence: Named maintainership/contact, review policy and API v1 compatibility contract are documented. Starter tooling validates using native installer rules, detects altered checksums, denies workspace permissions and preserves existing folders.
Outside-author trial remains https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/issues/4 and is not marked accepted by this automated fixture.

items.title: Notarized public Mac alpha
items.acceptance: Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, downloadable checksums/source and independent install/upgrade/recovery are verified before publishing.
evidence: Guarded preparation and recovery instructions are implemented. Apple identity/profile, actual notarization and independent installation/update/recovery remain https://github.com/JGOLD43/theon/issues/11; not accepted.
